projectDescription: A simple distributed voting application composed of multiple Docker containers, demonstrating multi-service orchestration with Docker Compose, Docker Swarm, and Kubernetes.
keyFeatures: Docker Compose support for local development
Docker Swarm stack deployment with horizontal scaling
Kubernetes deployment manifests for production clusters
Redis message queue for vote ingestion
PostgreSQL persistent storage for vote counts
Multi-stage Dockerfiles for dev and production builds
Configurable vote options via environment variables
publicApiSurface: Vote web app — HTTP GET/POST http://localhost:8080 (Docker Compose) or :31000 (Kubernetes)
Result web app — HTTP GET http://localhost:8081 (Docker Compose) or :31001 (Kubernetes)
Result WebSocket — Socket.IO 'scores' event emitted every 1s with vote counts
Environment variable OPTION_A — sets first vote option label (default: Cats)
Environment variable OPTION_B — sets second vote option label (default: Dogs)
docker compose up — starts all services locally
docker stack deploy --compose-file docker-stack.yml vote — deploys to Docker Swarm
kubectl create -f k8s-specifications/ — deploys to Kubernetes
docker compose --profile seed up -d — seeds the database with sample votes
